description: This file implements a key store for managing credentials and cryptographic keys within the Notesnook project. It includes classes and functions for handling encryption, decryption, key wrapping, credential management, and storage interactions, supporting features like password and security key credentials, with considerations for security and browser storage limitations.

classes.name: KeyStore
classes.description: A class managing cryptographic credentials, keys, and storage, supporting operations like registration, activation, deactivation, unlocking, locking, and credential management with encryption and decryption functionalities.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the key store by setting up storage and loading credentials and secrets.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new credential without secret into the store.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Removes a credential from the store.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates a credential, possibly wrapping its key for use.

methods.name: credentialHasKey
methods.description: Checks if a credential has an associated key.

methods.name: deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates a credential.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the key store with a credential, retrieving the cryptographic key.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the key store, resetting credentials and keys.

methods.name: relock
methods.description: Locks the key store, clearing the in-memory key.

methods.name: findCredential
methods.description: Finds a credential matching the query.

methods.name: hasCredential
methods.description: Checks if a credential exists.

methods.name: changeCredential
methods.description: Changes a credential's secret, re-encrypting the associated key.

methods.name: verifyCredential
methods.description: Verifies if a credential's key can be decrypted.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a secret value in the store, encrypting it.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts a secret value.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all credentials and secrets from storage.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Retrieves or generates the cryptographic key used for encryption.

methods.name: storeKey
methods.description: Stores a cryptographic key, possibly encrypting it for storage.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Loads stored credentials.

methods.name: getCredentialKey
methods.description: Generates a storage key for a credential.
